maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Top row keypoints are arranged in a horizontal linear sequence with roughly equidistant spacing, situated superior and parallel to the more densely populated secondary row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: High-density melanin distribution exceeding 95% across the visible apex of the rhinarium, appearing as uniform black pixels.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: 35-degree downward slope following a continuous, slightly convex contour from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip.

other_distinctive_markers: Maximum mandibular abduction exposing significant yellowing/calcification on the upper canines and visible black pigmentation on the oral mucosa of the lips.
